newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Durban wins S.Africa's biggest infrastructure loan.
newsitem.headline: Durban wins S.Africa's biggest infrastructure loan.

text.p: The Development Bank of Southern Africa said on Tuesday it would sign a 684 million rand infrastructural development loan agreement with the Durban Metropolitan Council on June 25.
The infrastructural loan, the largest yet granted to a local authority, will help finance four years of electricity, water supply, sanitation, drainage and urban renewal projects.
